title: App crashes on startup with NullPointerException
body: Every time I launch the app on v2.3.1 it throws a NullPointerException in the logs and closes immediately. This started after upgrading.

title: App crashes on launch, NPE in logcat
body: Since updating to 2.3.1 the app throws a NullPointerException and immediately closes on startup.

title: Feature request: dark mode
body: It would be nice to have a dark mode option in settings for night use.

title: Security vulnerability in auth token handling
body: Auth tokens are being logged in plaintext, which is a security vulnerability. Anyone with log access could hijack sessions.

title: How do I configure a custom API endpoint?
body: I can't find in the docs how to point the client at a self-hosted endpoint. How do I configure this?

title: README has a typo in the installation section
body: The README says 'pip instal' instead of 'pip install' in the documentation.
